semantic_meaning: Gregorian trading date (YYYYMMDD)
date_coverage: full instrument history returned by endpoint (sample 2011-07-13..2026-10-21; 3,695 rows)
pagination: no pagination; response is newest-first; /0 and /19900101 returned identical 3,695 rows/values
known_limitations: undocumented endpoint; parameter is ignored, not a real from-date; may be empty for expired instruments
evidence: live payload 2026-10-22; parameter A/B 3,695/3,695 exact rows; JSON dEven 10,539/10,539 exact

semantic_meaning: first traded price of the day (opening trade)
known_limitations: zero on some trade days (e.g. 2021-12-08 خساپا, 2021-03-09 نمرینو); zero on no-trade/suspension rows
evidence: live row 2012-12-24 = 3150; JSON priceFirst 10,539/10,539 exact; Bors chart open uses this field

semantic_meaning: daily maximum / minimum traded price
known_limitations: can be outside the close/first body in published rows; zero on no-trade rows; production widens the shadow, it never changes close
evidence: live 2012-12-24 HIGH=3339 LOW=3140; JSON priceMax/priceMin 10,539/10,539 exact; literal vs widen measured in raw parity

semantic_meaning: official closing price (قیمت پایانی) of the day
known_limitations: not the last trade; differs from <LAST> on most days; historical rows can be revised by TSETMC
evidence: live 2012-12-24 CLOSE=3264 vs LAST=3290; JSON pClosing 10,539/10,539 exact; field dictionary says pClosing=official closing

semantic_meaning: last traded price of the day (آخرین معامله)
known_limitations: zero/absent on no-trade rows; can be revised; differs from official closing
evidence: live 2012-12-24 LAST=3290; JSON pDrCotVal 10,539/10,539 exact; field dictionary says pDrCotVal=last trade

semantic_meaning: base price (قیمت پایه) = previous close or post-adjustment base, NOT the first trade
raw_adjusted: raw base, may carry corporate-action adjustment
known_limitations: using it as chart open is a field-mapping error; it is close(t-1) or adjusted base, not a traded open
evidence: live 2012-12-24 OPEN=3148 vs FIRST=3150; JSON priceYesterday 10,539/10,539 exact; production deliberately uses FIRST instead

semantic_meaning: daily traded volume (shares/units)
known_limitations: zero on no-trade rows; occasional source revision (sample 2026-06-20 differed by 495 shares between snapshot and current source)
evidence: live 2012-12-24 VOL=236610; JSON qTotTran5J 10,539/10,539 exact; product volume 99.97% exact in 9-symbol control

semantic_meaning: today opening price / first trade

pagination: top parameter; 2000 rows truncated 3 of 12 sampled assets
known_limitations: third-party docs say top=0 returns all; JSON and CSV agreed 10,539/10,539 on overlapping rows; JSON may omit rows present in CSV
evidence: live JSON 2026-06-20 priceFirst=11500; cross-check exact

semantic_meaning: daily maximum / minimum traded price
known_limitations: same as CSV HIGH/LOW; JSON may be capped at the requested top
evidence: 10,539/10,539 exact against CSV HIGH/LOW

semantic_meaning: official closing price

semantic_meaning: last traded price
known_limitations: different from pClosing; 0 on no-trade rows

semantic_meaning: last traded price (empirically), not official closing
raw_adjusted: unadjusted by mode name; produced by Rahavard pipeline

evidence: 2,595 assets / 1,192,071 common dates; type0-vs-product last 99.955%, vs closing 14.09%; 190,287 flat bars; raw-ohlc-type0-parity.csv

evidence: frozen ref_bars_v2.jsonl; 2,595 assets, type0+type7
